title: Noun Clause
voiceover: Noun Clause üç sinyal. That, olduğunu anlamı. He said that he was tired. What, ne sorusuna cevap. Tell me what you did. If veya Whether, evet hayır sorusu. I wonder if he will come. Say think believe, then that. Ask wonder not sure, then if. Daha fazlası sinyal-avcisi.com. Odaklan ve kazan.

slides.title: NOUN CLAUSE
slides.formula:
THAT → olduğunu | WHAT → ne
IF / WHETHER → mi / mı
slides.example:
He said that he was tired.
I wonder if he will come.
slides.tip:
say/think/believe → THAT
ask/wonder/not sure → IF / WHETHER
